svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Torque tube 845 long. Arms 812 of RHS, axle centres 900 from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tube centre; near arm 55 in from the near end, far arm 795.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld both arms on a flat jig so the axle holes line up within 1.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Reel end of each arm: a 100 x 90 x 40 block bored 60 for the bush;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: near block sawn and bolted (cap); far block open at the top (saddle).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two lever plates 280 x 50 x 8 on the tube behind the pivot, 50 apart

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inside, holes 16.5 at 250 from the tube centre for the nut block.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Press in the UHMW bushes: 40 bore at the near end, 60.3 at the far.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: near bush turns on the jackshaft, far bush on the pivot tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: axle bar passes both blocks with the tube on a 40/60 mandrel.
